metaDescription: Order custom poly propylene mason jars in bulk. Durable, lightweight, and shatterproof. Perfect for events and giveaways.
introHtml: Custom poly propylene mason jars offer the classic look of glass without the weight or breakage risk. Made from durable, BPA-free plastic, these jars are ideal for outdoor events, corporate picnics, or safety-conscious workplaces where glass is not allowed. They accept full-color screen printing or pad printing for crisp logos, and they hold up to repeated use. Choose poly propylene mason jars for a practical, reusable giveaway that stands out.
